newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to enjoy strong 1997 growth - accountants.
newsitem.headline: Canada to enjoy strong 1997 growth - accountants.

text.p: The Canadian economy will improve sharply in 1997, with output expected to rise about 3.5 percent, more than double the 1.4 percent posted this year, accountancy firm Ernst & Young forecast on Tuesday.

Much stronger performance by the housing sector, combined with continuing focus on machinery and equipment investment and further penetration in export markets will be the major drivers for the improvement, Ernst and Young said.
The firm's 1997 forecast also foresees consumer spending contributing more substantially to economic growth.
